title: multi record replaces the rows of an earlier rep that ran at the same start commit with the same case and knobs
goal: two reps of one case and knob set started at the same commit are both kept by multi record (rows averaged with runs 2, or told apart), so the 28 paid runs of ST-xjtqwdtq record all 128.54 USD in benchmarks.csv, not the 104.58 left after the second rep replaced the first

run:
import csv, subprocess, sys, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="reps-")); out = tmp / "r.csv"
def sh(*a):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "multi", *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stdout + p.stderr
def rows():
    return list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding="utf-8")))
try:
    for n in (1, 2):
        d = str(tmp / f"rep{n}")
        sh("run", "lookups", "--replay", "--dir", d)
        sh("record", "--dir", d, "--out", str(out))
        sh("remove", "--dir", d)
        one = len(rows()) if n == 1 else one
    assert len(rows()) > one or any(r["runs"] == "2" for r in rows()), "rep 2 replaced rep 1"
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
